architecture.mechanism: Rapid technological advancements in newer components close the reliability gap, giving replacement parts a comparable lifespan even under more intensive use.
architecture.intervention: Replace the failed catalytic converter on the Hyundai engine with the current-production, technologically updated OEM unit (and verify/clear engine codes) as a warranty-covered repair to restore drivability.
architecture.expected_effect: Drivability is restored and recurrence risk falls because the updated replacement achieves a comparable lifespan even under intensive use.
architecture.falsification_test: After the warranty-covered replacement, log mileage and re-scan for catalytic-converter efficiency codes or a flashing engine light over a fixed interval; any recurrence within that interval falsifies the mechanism.
